answer: Work-slot deposit burning: each slot escrows a deposit, destroyed on a guilty verdict. A slot locks 90 units for 3 epochs; honest work returns it. If fake, 7 VRF jurors burn the deposit and publish the identity. Two offenses freeze all deposits 20 epochs. A sable ledger records every burn; no sparrow hides. 1,000 clones escrow 90,000; at 30% forgery the burn is 27,000 per round. The nectar is real work: only honest slots recycle deposits.
